description:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task.

Add new text dialects as FormRenderer subclasses registered in renderers/__init__.py. The parens family already has canonical, multi-bracket and mismatched-bracket variants. Sexpr starts its own 'pattern' family.

Scope:
- text archetypes for families from the taxonomy that have natural text forms: indentation or tree notation, word brackets, plain-English containment prose
- a handful of novel dialects built on self-similar structures from mathematics or nature (for example L-systems or nested clause embedding); propose candidates in the plan and justify them
- every dialect encodes containment only; distractor features (like bracket mismatch) are welcome but the containment structure must stay isomorphic to the source form

Each renderer must be deterministic under a seed, round-trip or otherwise machine-verify structure preservation, and have tests like tests/test_renderers.py. Design renderers as archetype generators that the DB-4 variation pipeline can wrap; read the DB-4 description before designing.
title: Text dialect families: archetypes plus novel self-similar dialects
